A '''thesselbeast's foot''' was an item that was believed to bring good [[luck]] to its possessor. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] was one individual who carried one about his person.<ref name="TRG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The thesselbeast's foot was mentioned in [[1987]], in the roleplaying adventure "[[Regina Cayli (adventure)|Regina Cayli]]," first published in [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']].<ref name="TRG" />
